name: Keystroke-Level Model
axiom: Expert task time sums discrete operator durations: keystroke, pointing, homing, mental, and response.
trigger: A task feels slow although no single step is slow; the time goes into small transitions.

checklist.text: Count keystrokes, pointer moves, and mental pauses along the fastest path to the goal.
Keep hands on one device: tab order and shortcuts beat mouse-to-keyboard hops.
Auto-advance focus in segmented fields such as one-time codes.
Name fields plainly so people do not pause to decode them before typing.

antiPattern.violation: A six-digit code sits in six boxes, so each digit needs a click and then a key.
antiPattern.remediation: One field accepts the whole code, pasted or typed, and validates once.

parametricParams.caption: TOTAL TIME IS THE SUM OF OPERATORS

academicOrigin.title: The Keystroke-Level Model for User Performance Time with Interactive Systems
